notes: ZOMBIES POWER-UPS: zombies sometimes drop a glowing power-up - walk through it. RE-UP (max ammo for everyone), HOTBOX (one hit kills for 30 s), DOUBLE BAG (double points for 30 s), KUSH BOMB (every zombie down, +400), THE FIXER (+200, and it will fix the barricades) and the 420 SALE (the mystery crate costs 42 points for 30 s). They blink out after 25 seconds; timers show at the bottom of the screen. In co-op everyone gets them.

WALL STASHES: guns stashed in the walls behind purple spray-paint stencils - walk up and press USE to buy the gun, or its ammo for half price if you have it. The hospital has 4 (VIPER 9, MK18 CQBR, BREACHER 12, M4A1 upstairs) and THE WORKS has 5 (adds the RPK in the boiler house).
